CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS creative_profiles (user_id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,version INTEGER NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS creative_briefs (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL,data MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX creative_brief_owner(user_id,created_at))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS creative_wishes (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL,title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,category VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX creative_wish_status(status,created_at),INDEX creative_wish_owner(user_id,created_at))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS creative_wish_interests (wish_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,kind VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(wish_id,user_id,kind),INDEX creative_interest_owner(user_id,kind))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS creative_concepts (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,wish_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX creative_concept_wish(wish_id,status,created_at),INDEX creative_concept_owner(user_id,created_at))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS creative_stories (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,product_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL,data MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX creative_story_status(status,created_at),INDEX creative_story_owner(user_id,created_at))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS creative_templates (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,product_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL,data MEDIUMTEXT NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX creative_template_status(status,created_at),INDEX creative_template_owner(user_id,created_at))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS creative_contributions (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,story_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,version INTEGER NOT NULL,data TEXT NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX creative_contribution_story(story_id,status,created_at),INDEX creative_contribution_owner(user_id,created_at))
